- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure (tests, one doc section, one code comment)

## Summary

Develop schedule 72675160 (develop 2838e2695) has three test failure families. Each test still pinned an old contract. There is one commit per family; no product code changes.

| Family | Lanes | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_softmax_knobs.py::test_mirror_agrees_with_the_engine_rows_and_config_tables[*-mxfp8]` (11) | every `python:dev` / `python:rel` / wheel lane | #1488 serves THD on the Rubin MXFP8 row at d256 (`thd_d_shapes={(256, 256)}`); the test-side mirror `softmax_knobs.py` still treats all MXFP8 THD as unserved | The mirror serves MXFP8 THD at d256, dense K/V only (the row declines THD over pools). The pins follow the row. |
| `test_grouped_dgeglu_autograd` (4) | `python/gemm/cutedsl` 4.7 / 4.8 sm100 since schedule 72349147 | torch 2.14 zeroes `clamp`'s gradient on the boundary itself (2.11 / 2.13 pass it); the test deliberately puts inputs on ±limit, so the fp64 autograd oracle moved with the CI image's torch | The oracle uses an explicit closed-interval clamp, the kernel's convention, so it no longer depends on the torch version |
| `gated_attention_block` dense `S % 128 != 0` decline pins (15) | `python/*/cutedsl` 4.8 sm107 | #1520 masks a mask-free KV tail in-kernel, so the SDPA adapter no longer raises "multiple of 128" (`DID NOT RAISE`) | The dense-tail cells now run and are checked (below); docs follow |
| `test_ref_cache.py::test_the_reference_sources_are_closed_under_their_own_imports` (1) | every `python:dev` / `python:rel` lane | #1479 / #1481 made `sdpa/fp8.py` and `sdpa/mxfp8.py` import `sdpa/fp16.py`, which `_REF_SOURCES` does not list | `_REF_SOURCES` lists `sdpa/fp16.py` |
| `test_fp8_first_use_on_an_explicit_stream_reads_nothing_the_ambient_stream_wrote[class]` (1, this PR's first pipeline 72691773) | `python/*/cutedsl` 4.8 sm107 | `memory_allocated()` went *down* across `compile()` (6114350080 -> 6098852864): an earlier test's cyclic garbage was collected mid-compile | `gc.collect()` before the baseline, in the fp8 and mxfp8 twins; the equality stays exact |

## Why

**dGEGLU.** On torch 2.14.1 the kernel's `d_row` matches the analytic closed-interval derivative to 1.9e-7 relative, and `dprob` matches autograd to 1.8e-7. All 1078 of 131072 cells where kernel and autograd disagree hold an input of exactly ±7.0. Central differences on 12 interior cells agree three ways (FD, autograd, kernel). Boundary gradient of `x.clamp(-7, 7)` at `x = [-7, 0, 7]`:

| torch | gradient |
|---|---|
| 2.11.0, 2.13.0 | `[1, 1, 1]` |
| 2.14.1 | `[0, 1, 0]` |

The green job (473962714) and the first red one (475494701) use the same image tag `cudnn_13.4.1` and the same DSL wheel. The red image was rebuilt: cuda-pathfinder 1.6.1 → 1.8.1, and quack-kernels 0.6.2 is present. A local bisect over the six commits in the break window, starting with b220335e4, which predates the green schedule, fails on every commit under torch 2.14.1, so no FE commit caused it. `import quack` is ruled out: with and without it, 4 fail before the fix.

**GAB dense tail.** The dense-tail cells now run instead of pinning the decline:
- inference FP8 (unfused and fused) and MXFP8: S=1000 against the fake-quant oracle at the matrix's cosine floor; MXFP8 also checks every output cell was written;
- the quantized training forward's `s992_dense_b2` cells: bitwise against the inference block;
- the bf16 backward's dense S=1000 cells: against fp64 autograd at the module's bounds;
- a new dense `s992` quantized backward cell (FP8 and MXFP8): finite gradients plus the existing bitwise layer (quantizers, scalars, `delta`), the same standard as the launch-only cells.

The backward pads K/V with zeros, so pad columns add nothing to dQ, and real dK / dV columns do not read them. The forward's Stats now comes from the masked tail.

## Not in this PR

`test_block_thd_backward.py::test_thd_zero_length_sequence_bwd[trailing_empties_T5-*]` and `test_thd_fused_gate_bwd_sweep[one_tail_tile_T5]` (`dw_k_norm` 1.141 of its bound) fail identically on #1471's own pipeline (job 476727868) and #1497's (job 476908070), before #1520. They are pre-existing and left to the GAB owner.

## Related issues

#1425 / #1520 (KV-tail mask), #1488 (MXFP8 THD at d256).

## API and compatibility impact

None. Tests, one doc section in `docs/fe-oss-apis/gated_attention_block.md`, and one comment in `gated_attention_block/api.py`.

The two traps are recorded in AGENTS.md: torch 2.14's clamp boundary gradient (`test/AGENTS.md`), and GAB tests pinning SDPA adapter declines on the `oss` lanes (`python/cudnn/sdpa/AGENTS.md`).

## Testing

B200, DSL 4.7.0 cu13, cuDNN 9.27:
- `sdpa/test_softmax_knobs.py`: 56 passed.
- `sdpa/test_ref_cache.py`: 17 passed (the closure pin failed before the fix).
- `gemm/cutedsl/test_grouped_dgeglu_autograd.py`: 4 passed on torch 2.14.1 and on torch 2.13.0 (4 failed on torch 2.14.1 before the fix).
- GAB: the edited files collect (522 tests). They need SM107 hardware, so CI's `python/*/cutedsl:cutlass-4.8:sm107` lane is their run.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.

- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure (tests, one doc section, one code comment)

## Summary

Develop schedule 72675160 (develop 2838e2695) has three test failure families. Each test still pinned an old contract. There is one commit per family; no product code changes.

| Family | Lanes | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_softmax_knobs.py::test_mirror_agrees_with_the_engine_rows_and_config_tables[*-mxfp8]` (11) | every `python:dev` / `python:rel` / wheel lane | #1488 serves THD on the Rubin MXFP8 row at d256 (`thd_d_shapes={(256, 256)}`); the test-side mirror `softmax_knobs.py` still treats all MXFP8 THD as unserved | The mirror serves MXFP8 THD at d256, dense K/V only (the row declines THD over pools). The pins follow the row. |
| `test_grouped_dgeglu_autograd` (4) | `python/gemm/cutedsl` 4.7 / 4.8 sm100 since schedule 72349147 | torch 2.14 zeroes `clamp`'s gradient on the boundary itself (2.11 / 2.13 pass it); the test deliberately puts inputs on ±limit, so the fp64 autograd oracle moved with the CI image's torch | The oracle uses an explicit closed-interval clamp, the kernel's convention, so it no longer depends on the torch version |
| `gated_attention_block` dense `S % 128 != 0` decline pins (15) | `python/*/cutedsl` 4.8 sm107 | #1520 masks a mask-free KV tail in-kernel, so the SDPA adapter no longer raises "multiple of 128" (`DID NOT RAISE`) | The dense-tail cells now run and are checked (below); docs follow |
| `test_ref_cache.py::test_the_reference_sources_are_closed_under_their_own_imports` (1) | every `python:dev` / `python:rel` lane | #1479 / #1481 made `sdpa/fp8.py` and `sdpa/mxfp8.py` import `sdpa/fp16.py`, which `_REF_SOURCES` does not list | `_REF_SOURCES` lists `sdpa/fp16.py` |
| `test_fp8_first_use_on_an_explicit_stream_reads_nothing_the_ambient_stream_wrote[class]` (1, this PR's first pipeline 72691773) | `python/*/cutedsl` 4.8 sm107 | `memory_allocated()` went *down* across `compile()` (6114350080 -> 6098852864): an earlier test's cyclic garbage was collected mid-compile | `gc.collect()` before the baseline, in the fp8 and mxfp8 twins; the equality stays exact |

## Why

**dGEGLU.** On torch 2.14.1 the kernel's `d_row` matches the analytic closed-interval derivative to 1.9e-7 relative, and `dprob` matches autograd to 1.8e-7. All 1078 of 131072 cells where kernel and autograd disagree hold an input of exactly ±7.0. Central differences on 12 interior cells agree three ways (FD, autograd, kernel). Boundary gradient of `x.clamp(-7, 7)` at `x = [-7, 0, 7]`:

| torch | gradient |
|---|---|
| 2.11.0, 2.13.0 | `[1, 1, 1]` |
| 2.14.1 | `[0, 1, 0]` |

The green job (473962714) and the first red one (475494701) use the same image tag `cudnn_13.4.1` and the same DSL wheel. The red image was rebuilt: cuda-pathfinder 1.6.1 → 1.8.1, and quack-kernels 0.6.2 is present. A local bisect over the six commits in the break window, starting with b220335e4, which predates the green schedule, fails on every commit under torch 2.14.1, so no FE commit caused it. `import quack` is ruled out: with and without it, 4 fail before the fix.

**GAB dense tail.** The dense-tail cells now run instead of pinning the decline:
- inference FP8 (unfused and fused) and MXFP8: S=1000 against the fake-quant oracle at the matrix's cosine floor; MXFP8 also checks every output cell was written;
- the quantized training forward's `s992_dense_b2` cells: bitwise against the inference block;
- the bf16 backward's dense S=1000 cells: against fp64 autograd at the module's bounds;
- a new dense `s992` quantized backward cell (FP8 and MXFP8): finite gradients plus the existing bitwise layer (quantizers, scalars, `delta`), the same standard as the launch-only cells.

The backward pads K/V with zeros, so pad columns add nothing to dQ, and real dK / dV columns do not read them. The forward's Stats now comes from the masked tail.

## Not in this PR

`test_block_thd_backward.py::test_thd_zero_length_sequence_bwd[trailing_empties_T5-*]` and `test_thd_fused_gate_bwd_sweep[one_tail_tile_T5]` (`dw_k_norm` 1.141 of its bound) fail identically on #1471's own pipeline (job 476727868) and #1497's (job 476908070), before #1520. They are pre-existing and left to the GAB owner.

## Related issues

#1425 / #1520 (KV-tail mask), #1488 (MXFP8 THD at d256).

## API and compatibility impact

None. Tests, one doc section in `docs/fe-oss-apis/gated_attention_block.md`, and one comment in `gated_attention_block/api.py`.

The two traps are recorded in AGENTS.md: torch 2.14's clamp boundary gradient (`test/AGENTS.md`), and GAB tests pinning SDPA adapter declines on the `oss` lanes (`python/cudnn/sdpa/AGENTS.md`).

## Testing

B200, DSL 4.7.0 cu13, cuDNN 9.27:
- `sdpa/test_softmax_knobs.py`: 56 passed.
- `sdpa/test_ref_cache.py`: 17 passed (the closure pin failed before the fix).
- `gemm/cutedsl/test_grouped_dgeglu_autograd.py`: 4 passed on torch 2.14.1 and on torch 2.13.0 (4 failed on torch 2.14.1 before the fix).
- GAB: the edited files collect (522 tests). They need SM107 hardware, so CI's `python/*/cutedsl:cutlass-4.8:sm107` lane is their run.
